# Settings

<!-- Generated by `go generate .` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

lazyaria reads its settings from these places. A later one wins over an
earlier one:

1. The built-in default, shown below.
2. The config file, `~/.config/lazyaria/config.toml` (see
   [Files and paths](files-and-paths.md)).
3. An environment variable: `LAZYARIA_` and the key in capitals, with
   dots as underscores. `downloads.dir` is `LAZYARIA_DOWNLOADS_DIR`.
4. A value saved with `lazyaria config set`. `lazyaria config reset`
   removes it again.
5. A command-line flag, such as `lazyaria daemon --mode`.

`lazyaria config list` shows every key, its current value and where the
value came from. `lazyaria config list --json` prints the same as JSON,
with the type, default, allowed values and help text of each key, and
`not_used_yet`, which is true for a setting nothing reads yet.

In the config file, each section below is a TOML table:

```toml
version = 1

[downloads]
max_concurrent = 3
min_split_size = "8M"
```

Sizes are a number with an optional K, M, G or T (1K is 1024 bytes).
Durations are written like `30s`, `5m` or `1h`. On the command line a list is
comma separated (`429,network`); in the file it is a TOML array.

The **Applies** column says when a change takes effect: **now**, or after
the daemon **restarts**. Settings marked *Not used yet* are read only by
the terminal interface, which is not released yet. `lazyaria config list`
marks them `(not used yet)`, and `lazyaria config set` saves one with a
warning.

## general

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `1` | restart | Config file format version. |

## downloads

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `downloads.dir` | empty | restart | Download directory; empty uses the XDG download dir or ~/Downloads. |
| `downloads.remember_last_dir` | `true` | now | Offer the last used directory for new jobs. *Not used yet.* |
| `downloads.max_concurrent` | `5` | now | Maximum downloads running at once. |
| `downloads.connections_per_server` | `16` | now | Connections per server (aria2 caps this at 16). |
| `downloads.split` | `16` | now | Pieces a file is split into. |
| `downloads.min_split_size` | `4M` | now | Do not split pieces smaller than this. |
| `downloads.start_paused` | `false` | now | Add new jobs in the paused state. |
| `downloads.on_exists` | `rename` | now | What to do when the target file exists. One of: `rename`, `overwrite`, `ask`. |
| `downloads.file_allocation` | `auto` | restart | File allocation method; auto picks per filesystem. One of: `auto`, `falloc`, `prealloc`, `trunc`, `none`. |
| `downloads.user_agent` | empty | now | HTTP user agent; empty uses the aria2 default. |
| `downloads.lowest_speed_limit` | `0` | now | Abort connections slower than this (bytes/s); 0 disables. |
| `downloads.connect_timeout` | `60s` | restart | Connection timeout. |
| `downloads.timeout` | `60s` | restart | Transfer timeout. |

## limits

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limits.global_down` | `0` | now | Global download limit (bytes/s); 0 is unlimited. |
| `limits.global_up` | `0` | now | Global upload limit (bytes/s); 0 is unlimited. |

## network

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `network.all_proxy` | empty | now | HTTP(S) proxy URL; empty falls back to environment variables. |
| `network.no_proxy` | empty | now | Comma separated hosts that bypass the proxy. |
| `network.check_certificate` | `true` | restart | Verify TLS certificates; a warning is shown when off. |
| `network.ca_certificate` | empty | restart | Path to a custom CA bundle. |
| `network.interface` | empty | restart | Bind to this network interface or IP. |
| `network.disable_ipv6` | `false` | restart | Disable IPv6. |

## retry

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `retry.max_tries` | `5` | restart | aria2 tries per connection. |
| `retry.retry_wait` | `10s` | restart | Wait between aria2 retries. |
| `retry.max_file_not_found` | `3` | restart | Give up after this many file-not-found replies. |
| `retry.auto_retry` | `429` | now | Failure kinds retried automatically. One of: `429`, `503`, `network`, `timeout`. |
| `retry.backoff_base` | `30s` | now | First automatic retry delay. |
| `retry.backoff_factor` | `2` | now | Multiplier applied to the delay on each retry. |
| `retry.backoff_max_attempts` | `5` | now | Maximum automatic retries per job. |

## bt

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bt.seed_ratio` | `0` | now | Seed until this share ratio; 0 means no ratio target. |
| `bt.seed_minutes` | `0` | now | Seed for this many minutes; 0 means do not seed. |
| `bt.listen_port` | `6881-6999` | restart | BitTorrent listen port or range. |
| `bt.dht_listen_port` | `6881-6999` | restart | DHT listen port or range. |
| `bt.enable_dht` | `true` | restart | Enable DHT. |
| `bt.enable_peer_exchange` | `true` | restart | Enable peer exchange. |
| `bt.max_peers` | `55` | restart | Maximum peers per torrent. |
| `bt.extra_trackers` | empty | restart | Trackers appended to every torrent. |
| `bt.require_crypto` | `false` | restart | Require encrypted peer connections. |
| `bt.save_metadata` | `true` | restart | Keep the .torrent for magnets (needed to resume). |

## daemon

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `daemon.mode` | `on-demand` | restart | Run the daemon on demand or keep it always running. One of: `on-demand`, `always`. |
| `daemon.idle_exit` | `30s` | now | Exit after this long with no clients and no work. |
| `daemon.auto_start` | `true` | restart | Clients start the daemon when it is missing. |

## engine

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine.aria2c_path` | `aria2c` | restart | Path or name of the aria2c binary. |
| `engine.attach_url` | empty | restart | Attach to an existing aria2 RPC endpoint instead of spawning one. |
| `engine.attach_secret_file` | empty | restart | File holding the secret for the attached endpoint. |
| `engine.aria2_extra_args` | empty | restart | Extra aria2c arguments; rpc-* options are rejected. |
| `engine.disk_cache` | `64M` | restart | aria2 disk cache size. |
| `engine.auto_save_interval` | `10s` | restart | How often aria2 saves its session. |
| `engine.restart_max_backoff` | `30s` | restart | Longest wait between aria2 restarts. |
| `engine.crash_loop_exits` | `5` | restart | Exits within the window that count as a crash loop. |
| `engine.crash_loop_window` | `3s` | restart | Window used to detect a crash loop. |

## reliability

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reliability.inhibit_sleep` | `true` | now | Keep the system awake while downloading. |
| `reliability.inhibit_mode` | `block` | now | Sleep inhibit mode. One of: `block`, `delay`. |
| `reliability.disk_precheck` | `true` | now | Check free space before starting a job. |
| `reliability.disk_margin_percent` | `1` | now | Extra free space required, in percent. |
| `reliability.duplicates` | `ask` | now | How to handle a URL that is already queued. One of: `ask`, `allow`, `skip`. |
| `reliability.unmounted_guard` | `true` | now | Refuse to write when the target mount is missing. |

## remove

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `remove.default_action` | `ask` | now | Default action when removing a job. One of: `ask`, `list-only`, `trash`. *Not used yet.* |
| `remove.undo_seconds` | `10` | now | Seconds an undo stays available; 0 disables undo. |
| `remove.confirm` | `true` | now | Ask before removing. *Not used yet.* |

| `history.purge_removed_after_days` | `30` | now | Days before removed jobs are purged. |

| `ui.double_click_ms` | `400` | now | Double click interval in milliseconds. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.glyphs` | `unicode` | now | Glyph set. One of: `unicode`, `ascii`. *Not used yet.* |

| `ui.time_format` | `relative` | now | Timestamp format. One of: `relative`, `24h`, `12h`, `iso`. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.details_position` | `auto` | now | Where the details pane goes. One of: `auto`, `right`, `bottom`, `hidden`. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.details_width_percent` | `34` | now | Details pane width in percent. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.wide_breakpoint` | `100` | now | Columns at which the wide layout starts. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.sort` | `smart` | now | Default list sort. One of: `smart`, `added`, `name`, `progress`, `speed`, `size`. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.paste_detection` | `true` | now | Offer to add URLs found in pasted text. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.toast_seconds` | `4` | now | Seconds a toast stays visible. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.sparkline_seconds` | `60` | now | Seconds of speed history in sparklines. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.window_title` | `true` | now | Set the terminal window title. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.title_format` | `lazyaria ↓ {down} · {active} active` | now | Window title template. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.osc_links` | `true` | now | Use OSC 8 hyperlinks. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.clipboard` | `auto` | now | Clipboard backend. One of: `auto`, `osc52`, `wl-copy`, `xclip`, `off`. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.open_command` | `xdg-open` | now | Command used to open files. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.open_folder_command` | empty | now | Command used to open folders; empty uses open_command. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.reduced_motion` | `false` | now | Turn off animation. *Not used yet.* |
| `ui.first_run` | `true` | restart | Show the first-run screen; cleared after it is shown. *Not used yet.* |

## log

|---|---|---|---|
| `log.level` | `info` | now | Log level. One of: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. |
| `log.file` | empty | restart | Log file path; empty uses the state dir. |

## advanced

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `advanced.progress_hz` | `4` | now | Maximum progress pushes per second per client. |
| `advanced.poll_interval` | `1s` | now | aria2 poll interval while observed. |
| `advanced.sentinel_interval` | `15s` | now | aria2 poll interval while unobserved. |

## keys

| Setting | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keys.preset` | `default` | now | Keymap preset. One of: `default`, `vim`. *Not used yet.* |

The config file may also hold one `keys.<action>` list per action, and a
`[theme]` table with one `theme.<role>` colour per role. *Not used yet.*
